territory.name: ASEAN-6 · Major Southeast Asian economies
territory.operatingRule: Require reviewed evidence of a relevant operating office, facility or domestic operating footprint in Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand or Vietnam. Parent HQ alone cannot localize a global initiative. Purchasing organization, HP account ownership and route-to-supply eligibility require separate qualification.
territory.verificationBasis: User clarified the region as the major ASEAN economies on 17 October 2026; implemented as the six priority markets ID, MY, PH, SG, TH and VN. This is a sales priority scope, not a claim that ASEAN has only six members.

presentation.dateBasis: User-selected presentation edition. Actual collection and audit timestamps remain in Research operations and machine-readable evidence records.
